answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fake identities. A newcomer must do paid work for 12 distinct counterparties, with none above a quarter of its volume. Clones trading only together form a closed mirror: one cluster, like an ember that never spreads, so rewards freeze. Forging 100 fakes needs 1,200 relationships at 5 credits each, 6,000 total. An honest agent pays 60 credits once, works across a mesa of partners, and keeps undiluted rewards.
